language.name: Ledger Investigations
language.rationale: This design language for The Ledger emphasizes clarity, authority, and the stark, direct nature of investigative journalism. By placing high-contrast typography directly over footage with a subtle accent, it ensures readability and gravitas, reflecting an ink-on-paper discipline adapted for broadcast without relying on traditional panels.

notes: structure and spacing: platform-owned (balanced density - 25/33px padding, 11px line gap, at scale 1)
accent: a rule under the words, one clear space below them
surface: no surface - the words sit on the picture
motion: reveal at measured pace → preset line-reveal
